name: Gifts Of God The
overview: Scripture reveals that the gifts of God are both abundant and purposeful, providing for the needs of His creation without requiring anxious effort from us. Jesus teaches that just as God clothes the lilies of the field and feeds the birds of the air, He will surely provide for His people, who are of greater value. These verses emphasize God's sovereign care and the free bestowal of life’s necessities, encouraging believers to trust in His provision rather than worry about daily needs.
